answer: Resist sybils with auctioned identity issuance: each epoch the network releases only a fixed number of new identity slots, sold to the highest bidders. A grove of fresh agents grows only as fast as slots open, and every slot is marble-carved into the ledger, one seat per winning bid. An attacker wanting ten thousand sybils must win ten thousand auctions, bidding against honest newcomers and paying market price per fake, while an honest agent buys one slot once. Flooding the network becomes a bidding war the attacker funds itself, and a timber-hard cap on slots keeps growth slower than forgery.
